name: cockpit
title: Cockpit
description: An instrument panel for your Mac: CPU, memory, disk, uptime, network speed, battery, and how much Codex and Claude usage you have left.
author: zellux

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Open Cockpit
commands.subtitle: Mac and AI usage at a glance
commands.description: View the enabled system, network, battery, Codex, and Claude metrics in one grid.

preferences.name: showCpu
preferences.title: CPU
preferences.description: Include current CPU utilization in the dashboard.
preferences.label: Show CPU usage

preferences.name: showMemory
preferences.title: Memory
preferences.description: Include current memory pressure and utilization.
preferences.label: Show memory usage

preferences.name: showDisk
preferences.title: Disk
preferences.description: Include usage for the selected volume.
preferences.label: Show disk usage

preferences.name: showUptime
preferences.title: Uptime
preferences.description: Include the time since this Mac was last started.
preferences.label: Show system uptime

preferences.name: showNetwork
preferences.title: Network
preferences.description: Include live upload and download throughput for the selected interface.
preferences.label: Show upload and download speed

preferences.name: showBattery
preferences.title: Battery
preferences.description: Include battery percentage, charging state, and estimated time remaining.
preferences.label: Show battery status

preferences.name: showCodex
preferences.title: Codex / GPT
preferences.description: Include remaining Codex usage windows from the signed-in Codex CLI.
preferences.label: Show remaining Codex usage

preferences.name: showSpark
preferences.title: Codex Spark
preferences.description: Include Spark rate-limit windows alongside the other Codex windows.
preferences.label: Show Spark usage

preferences.name: showClaude
preferences.title: Claude
preferences.description: Include remaining Claude five-hour and weekly usage from Claude Desktop.
preferences.label: Show remaining Claude usage

preferences.name: dashboardRefreshSeconds
preferences.title: Dashboard Refresh
preferences.description: How often live metric cards update. Manual refresh updates them immediately.

preferences.name: networkUnits
preferences.title: Network Units
preferences.description: Display network throughput as bytes or bits per second.

preferences.name: diskVolume
preferences.title: Disk Volume
preferences.description: Mount point to report disk usage for. Defaults to the startup volume.

preferences.name: networkInterface
preferences.title: Network Interface
preferences.description: Interface to measure, for example en0. Leave empty to follow the current default route.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Codex CLI executable. A bare name is resolved from PATH; use an absolute path to pin a specific install.

preferences.name: claudeUsagePath
preferences.title: Claude Usage File
preferences.description: Path to Claude Desktop's local plan usage history file.
